questionPolicy: Natural entity- or topic-scoped questions without file names, document IDs, page numbers, answer leakage, or hidden retrieval hints.
One physical page contains all material evidence for each new case.
No visual interpretation, table reconstruction, cross-page aggregation, or multi-step arithmetic is required.
Indexed evidence and original PDF pages were both checked before the paid run.
selectionQuality.excludedDataIssue: The public mi_phone.pdf artifact is byte-identical to NYU_graduate.pdf and contains NYU brochure pages rather than the claimed phone guide; its candidate question was removed before execution.

knownFailures.description: The single-page banker list for Godfrey Phillips India Limited is complete, but the agent returned INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
The Diane Hanson matter contains Filing ID 48897809 and Case Number 5152012 on its first page, but the agent returned INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
Eleventh Circuit case 21-13199 states the opinion date January 5, 2022 on its first page, but the agent returned INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

interpretation: All three observed mistakes are conservative false refusals; no answered case was manually judged factually wrong.

Automatic exact-match undercounts correct paraphrases, and automatic Gold-page counts are reduced by equivalent duplicate documents and repeated evidence pages; manual semantic review is the acceptance authority.
For ordinary single-page text questions with a clear entity or topic, the current v22 Agent is stable enough for the project demonstration scope.
